scripts.build:all: npm run build:linux-x64 && npm run build:linux-arm64 && npm run build:darwin-x64 && npm run build:darwin-arm64
scripts.build:linux-x64: rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl -p superdev && install -m 0755 target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/superdev packages/superdev-linux-x64/bin/superdev
scripts.build:linux-arm64: rustup target add aarch64-unknown-linux-musl && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl -p superdev && install -m 0755 target/aarch64-unknown-linux-musl/release/superdev packages/superdev-linux-arm64/bin/superdev
scripts.build:darwin-x64: rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin -p superdev && install -m 0755 target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/superdev packages/superdev-darwin-x64/bin/superdev
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin -p superdev && install -m 0755 target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/superdev packages/superdev-darwin-arm64/bin/superdev
scripts.test: cargo nextest run --workspace && npm run check:aokf
scripts.coverage:check: cargo +nightly llvm-cov clean --workspace && cargo +nightly llvm-cov nextest --workspace --no-report && cargo +nightly llvm-cov report --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'crates/app' --fail-under-lines 90 && cargo +nightly llvm-cov report --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'crates/lib' --fail-under-lines 90
